verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const f="lib/commerce/checkout.ts";if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error("SCAN-710: checkout.ts missing");process.exit(79)}const s=fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8");const paid=s.search(/\.update\(\{\s*status:\s*\x27paid\x27/);const gone=s.search(/\.update\(\{\s*status:\s*\x27cancelled\x27\s*\}\)/);if(paid<0||gone<0){console.error("SCAN-710: the paid or cancelled flip on commerce_orders was not found");process.exit(79)}const head=(i)=>s.slice(Math.max(0,i-220),i);const drops=(h)=>/const\s*\{\s*data:\s*updated\s*\}\s*=\s*await\s*db\(\)\s*\.from\(\x27commerce_orders\x27\)\s*$/.test(h);const bad=[];if(drops(head(paid)))bad.push("the pending-to-paid flip");if(drops(head(gone)))bad.push("the expired-session cancel");if(bad.length){console.error("SCAN-710: "+bad.join(" and ")+" in lib/commerce/checkout.ts still read only data from the update, so a transient database error is swallowed, the webhook acks 200, Stripe never redelivers and the paid order stays pending forever.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: recordCommerceOrderFromSession and abandonCommerceOrderFromSession in lib/commerce/checkout.ts read only data from their status-flip updates, so a PostgREST or network error (which supabase-js returns rather than throws) became an empty row list, the Stripe webhook acked 200 with the event claimed, and a paid order stayed pending forever (or an expired session kept its booking hold). Both flips now destructure error and throw naming the session id and the error message, matching recordTipRefund and setTier, so the webhook outer catch releases the claim and 500s for a pending-guarded, idempotent redelivery; settleCommerceOrderAction and the journey welcome page already catch. Pinned by three SCAN-710 cases in lib/commerce/checkout.test.ts: the paid flip rejects on a db error with nothing downstream run, the cancel flip rejects on a db error with no booking release, and a clean no-row result still resolves.
